title: Fix a bug
recap: Pipo Code fixed the More photos button.
funFact: Plan, build, fix: that's how real websites get made. Coding agents do the typing, and you decide what's safe to share.
postcard: Pipo and Kai cheering as a glowing More photos button works on a phone, {problem}
situation: Uh-oh, Grandpa says a button on your site doesn't work! Want me to fix it?
facts: 📱 Only on phones, fine on the laptop
👀 Check the fix before it goes online
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. You build their website with your tools. You do what they ask: if they ask you to put the fix online, you do it; if they ask to see the fix first, you prepare it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: fix_and_publish
tools.description: Fix the bug and put the fixed site online right away. Use this when the user wants it fixed live.

fix.description: What you changed, in one short sentence

page.description: Which page the fix is on

tools.name: prepare_fix
tools.description: Prepare the fix without putting it online, so the user can check it first. Use this when the user wants to see the fix first.

problem.description: The bug, in one short sentence

fix.description: What you changed, in one short sentence

page.description: Which page the fix is on

lines.text: Fix ready, waiting for your OK

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Fix the More photos button on the photos page
pieces.text: Fix the "More photos" button on the photos page of my site.

pieces.label: My site is broken, fix it
pieces.text: My site is broken, fix it.

slots.label: What does Pipo Code need to know?

pieces.label: It only breaks on phones
pieces.text: It only breaks on phones; on the laptop it works.

pieces.label: Tapping it does nothing
pieces.text: When you tap it, nothing happens.

pieces.label: Just rebuild the whole site!
pieces.tip: Rebuilding everything can break the parts that worked. Describe the one problem instead.

pieces.label: Show me the fix first
pieces.text: Show me the fix before it goes online.

flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know which bug, so it fixed the wrong thing.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code it only breaks on phones.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's a phone problem, so the fix might not help.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the fix first lets you test it before Grandpa does.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code changed the live site straight away, so you never tested the fix.

lesson: Describe a bug exactly: what, where and when it happens. Then check the fix.
